verdicts.tldr: the first-boot branch persists the genesis doc before it is validated, so a doc with an invalid chain_id is pinned and the corrected file is refused as a changed genesis
verdicts.details: First load: `error in genesis file: Genesis doc must include non-empty chain_id`, after saveGenesisDoc at node.go:1084 already wrote the doc. Second load with chain_id fixed: `genesis chain id mismatch between persisted state ("") and source genesis ("fixed")`. resetToGenesisDoc runs sm.MakeGenesisState before its write (node.go:1142-1146), the shape this branch repeats without. Only a provider that skips ValidateAndComplete reaches it, since GenesisDocFromFile validates at types/genesis.go:178; the base behaves the same, and recovery is wiping a data dir with nothing committed, hence Nit. Fix, mechanical: build or validate the genesis state before saveGenesisDoc in the first-boot branch.
